name: Kuro Inbox Webhook

meta.description: HTTP webhook for laptop Kuro: returns latest high-priority items + digest summary. Protect with header X-Kuro-Secret.

nodes.name: Inbox Webhook
nodes.notes: Production URL becomes N8N_INBOX_WEBHOOK_URL in Kuro .env

nodes.name: Gmail Open Important
nodes.notes: Runs when authorized; keep limit small

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile', temperature: 0.2, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'Summarize the user inbox list for spoken TTS. Reply with 1-2 short sentences. No markdown. If empty say there is nothing urgent.' }, { role: 'user', content: $input.all().map(i => `${i.json.from}: ${i.json.subject}`).join('\n') || 'No unread important mail.' } ] }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, spoken: $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || 'No urgent mail.', items: $('Gmail Open Important').all().slice(0, 5).map(i => ({ from: i.json.from, subject: i.json.subject })) }) }}

notes: After import: wire IF on Check Secret ok===true → Gmail path, else → Respond Unauthorized. Copy Production webhook URL into Kuro N8N_INBOX_WEBHOOK_URL.
